login.title: Sign in
login.subtitle: Follow your files with your lawyer's office.

uploads.hint: PDF, Word, Excel or images, up to {{max}} MB each.
uploads.empty: You have not sent any document on this file.

status.FAILED: Could not be checked, send it again

invoices.title: Invoices

contact.title: Contact your lawyer
